name: Cocoyam Mosaic
description: A viral disease causing mosaic patterns and leaf distortion in cocoyam. It is transmitted by aphids and through infected planting material, reducing photosynthesis and corm yield.
symptoms: Light green to yellow mosaic patterns on leaves
Reduced leaf size and stunted plant growth
Reduced corm size and overall yield
causes: Use of infected cormels for planting
Alternative weed hosts harboring the virus
treatments: No curative treatment for viral infection
Remove and destroy severely infected plants
Control aphid vectors with neem oil or insecticidal soap
prevention: Control aphid populations in and around fields
Remove weed hosts near cocoyam fields
